title: Shougi Matsuri
overview:
Packed with rich data made possible because it is a product planned by the Japan Shogi Association!

10,000 Famous Games Included!
The famous game viewing mode contains 10,000 famous games. You can take your time studying past famous games by professional shogi players. Searches are instant, so there is no waiting.

400 Tsume Shogi Problems Included!
The Tsume Shogi Dojo contains 400 tsume shogi problems divided into four levels: beginner to advanced, and classic.

250 Next Move Problems Included!
Answer next-move problems in a three-choice format. 20 problems are given in a row out of all 250, and your shogi strength is diagnosed from your rate of correct answers.

Match Play
You can play shogi against the computer at three strength levels. Of course, handicap and piece-handicap settings are as you like. You can also take part in a shogi tournament with computer players.

㈳日本将棋連盟の企画製品だから実現した充実したデータが満載！

名局一万局収録！
名局鑑賞モードには一万局の名局を収録。プロ棋士の過去の名局をじっくり鑑賞することができます。検索時間は瞬時でお待たせしません。

詰将棋400題収録！
詰将棋道場では初級～上級、古典の４段階にわかれた400題の詰将棋問題が収録されています。

次の一手250題収録！
次の一手問題に３択形式で答えます。全250題の中から20題が連続して出題されます。その正解率からあなたの棋力の診断が行われます。

対局
３段階の強さのコンピュータと将棋対局ができます。もちろん、手合い、駒落ち設定も思いのまま。コンピュータプレイヤーとの将棋大会にも参加できます。
